value.purpose: Mandatory Release diagnostics.artifactEndpoint=https://apps-geonical.ru/error-artifacts and write-only diagnostics.artifactUploadToken. Debug/verification production values are empty. Archives contain only already-approved SDK envelopes; no expanded GIS/log/photo scan. Private input filename: diagnostics.properties; the source path points to the public authoritative declaration because private inputs are never manufactured or tracked. Approved existing archive values map from private Desktop LISA_ERROR_REPORT_ARTIFACTS_URL/LISA_ERROR_REPORT_UPLOAD_TOKEN (or server desktop-envs.fragment); verify the upload token against configured/running UPLOAD_TOKEN_SHA256. Android receives only explicit private build inputs and never reads Desktop files at runtime. Operator read credentials are separate.
